title: dotfiles package build dependencies
description: Maps a package key from packages.json to the apt packages required to build/install it. Keys must exist in packages.json (also enforced by the playbook assert). A key's deps are installed only when that package is selected for the active profile, in one apt transaction before any per-source install/build task.

$schema.description: Editor pointer only; the playbook strips this key before treating values as dep entries.
